_about: Fabric £ per metre for codes the production planner's cost list does not carry. 'exact' entries win over the planner's list; 'prefix' entries only fill gaps (any code starting with the prefix that has no price elsewhere).

_notes.CMP-WEB-PU-25-: all other colours of 25mm polyurethane webbing, e.g. -11 yellow, -15 navy
